description: Assam has signed MoUs with six organisations to integrate AI into school education. The partnerships will focus on teacher training, foundational literacy, personalised learning, digital skills and supporting out-of-school adolescents, with around 1 lakh teachers targeted for AI training by May 2027.
body_lead: Guwahati: The Assam government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with six organisations to collaborate on the introduction and use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the state's school education system, a minister said. The tie-ups will help create an inclusive and learner-centric education ecosystem, Assam Education minister Ranoj Pegu said. "A significant step towards future-ready education in Assam!
